description: WP-O6 Codex: Orks (11e) MOBBED (Beast Snagga Boyz, passive): when the unit ends a charge move, each enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with it makes a battle-shock roll at -1 (-2 with 13+ models). Fixture ork11e_ab_charge: the Beast Snagga Boyz charge the Contemptor-Achillus (declared, rolled and moved with the engine's charge tools): the Contemptor's battle-shock roll with the -1 is logged.

steps.comment: decline re-rolls (not under test); the 2D6 is enough for the 3.5" gap
the APPLY_CHARGE_MOVE the charge tools send (engine charge-move solver)
